description: This file defines the OAuthClientRepository class, which provides methods for managing OAuth client data using Prisma ORM, including finding, creating, updating, and deleting OAuth clients.

classes.name: OAuthClientRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing OAuth client data with methods for querying and modifying OAuth clients in the database.

methods.name: findByClientId
methods.description: Finds an OAuth client by its client ID, returning specific fields.

methods.name: findByClientIdWithSecret
methods.description: Finds an OAuth client by its client ID, including the client secret.

methods.name: findByClientIdIncludeUser
methods.description: Finds an OAuth client by its client ID, including associated user information.

methods.name: findByUserId
methods.description: Finds all OAuth clients associated with a specific user ID.

methods.name: findByUserIdAndStatus
methods.description: Finds OAuth clients by user ID and status.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves all OAuth clients with associated user info.

methods.name: findByStatus
methods.description: Finds OAuth clients by their status.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new OAuth client with specified data, generating a client ID and setting client type based on PKCE enablement.

methods.name: updateStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of an OAuth client identified by client ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates specified fields of an OAuth client identified by client ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an OAuth client by client ID.
